reviewer: generation-6 breadth lane (vit replacement) — verify-first probe + route-complete Chrome matrix

rubric.evidence: Exact CDN @huggingface/transformers@3.7.5 image-classification pipeline loaded Xenova/mobilevit-small (canonical ONNX mirror of apple/mobilevit-small) fp32 on WASM in headless Chrome: ledgered two-cats fixture → Egyptian cat 46.1% / tiger cat 16.2% / tabby 10.1% over a real [1000] logit vector (485 distinct logit values) in ~10 s including first download. acceptance-run.json retains the route×viewport matrix.
rubric.notes: Canonical conversion identifies base_model apple/mobilevit-small; no raw ORT or substitute.

rubric.evidence: Upstream config declares MobileViTForImageClassification, image_size 256, 1,000 ImageNet labels with id2label; the worker exposes the actual [1000] logits, computes one softmax, and returns labelled top-k, entropy, and top-1 margin. Probe semantic sanity passed on the cats fixture.
rubric.notes: Overview asserts 1,000 classes, inside-table rows, cat semantic labels, and real latency at desktop and mobile.

rubric.evidence: Page and worker declare canonical runtime id Xenova/mobilevit-small, exact upstream apple/mobilevit-small checkpoint (Apple sample code license, HF card license=other), image-classification, WASM, fp32, ~23 MB (22,604,607-byte model.onnx); inference is in worker.js on the shared 3.7.5 pin.
rubric.notes: Canonical q8 was rejected after exact browser semantic failure (cats → jellyfish 18.1% with a sea-creature top-5); fp32 passed and is disclosed on-page (same precedent as mobilenetv4-conv-small).

rubric.evidence: All five routes use createModelLoader with the same literal model id/dtype/size and the shared ClassifierEngine worker; cached auto-init is asserted on every route after the first explicit Download; clear-cache remains available.
rubric.notes: No custom model Load button; literal model ids at every loader call site.

rubric.evidence: Shared loader owns absent/download/progress/retry/cache states; each inference page has role=status aria-live and renders caught errors visibly with .err.
rubric.notes: Practical route honestly labels the no-camera fallback (NotFoundError → ledgered sample through the same real worker).

rubric.evidence: Five-route ladder includes upload/drop/sample selection/top-k, user-initiated camera start/stop, degradation resolution/JPEG sliders (up to the model's 256×256 input), and the cascade threshold. The route-complete validator drives each primary action at desktop and mobile.
rubric.notes: All native controls are labelled; sample thumbnails have role/button, tabindex, and Enter/Space handlers.

rubric.evidence: All visible predictions originate from ClassifierEngine worker responses. The practical no-camera path loops a ledgered sample through the same real worker; the multi-model route runs BOTH MobileViT and the real ViT stage (Xenova/vit-base-patch16-224 via the built vit-image-classification worker) when forced uncertain.
Established classification family ladder preserves semantic headings, labelled native controls, keyboard sample/drop targets, image alt text, live status regions, and text alongside colour.
rubric.notes: Validator asserts accessible names, zero overflow, and retains screenshots at both viewports.

rubric.evidence: Uses existing design-system field-row/model-grid/versus-grid responsive patterns. Validator covers all five routes at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 and fails on horizontal overflow; screenshots /tmp/mobilevit-{route}-{desktop,mobile}.png retained.
Inference and model preprocessing run in a Web Worker; the camera loop allows only one inference at a time and pauses while hidden; frames are downscaled to 256×256 before transfer.

guidanceConsulted.query: off-main-thread inference web worker responsive UI
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep critical interaction handlers light, prioritize user-visible work, and avoid main-thread long tasks that harm INP.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: all preprocessing/inference runs in a dedicated module worker; the live camera loop is bounded to one request at a time and pauses while hidden.

guidanceConsulted.query: off-main-thread inference web worker responsive UI
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Break up heavy synchronous processing so the browser can handle input and repaint.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: no model inference on the main thread; the worker posts results per request and the UI updates incrementally (bars/readout per frame).

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible range slider with live region feedback
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic native controls, explicit labels, and accessible live status for dynamic work.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: native labelled range inputs (top-k, resolution, JPEG quality, cascade threshold) with visible value read-outs, keyboard-operable samples, role=status aria-live regions, and text error states on all five routes.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible range slider with live region feedback
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Match native form controls to the site palette (accent-color) instead of replacing them with custom components.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: all controls are native elements styled by the shared design system; no custom slider/progress widgets were hand-rolled.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: public/styles.css design system; shared <model-download-status> via createModelLoader

guidanceConsulted.query: off-main-thread inference web worker responsive UI
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pause background JavaScript execution when the component is off-screen and resume just-in-time.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the practical camera loop checks document.hidden every frame and pauses capture/inference while the tab is hidden.

openQuestions: Can a future faithful per-channel int8 export of MobileViT-Small preserve the fp32 semantic ranking while cutting the 23 MB graph?
Would the 256×256-native input benefit from letterboxing instead of centre-crop on very wide webcam frames?
summary: MobileViT-Small (apple/mobilevit-small via the canonical Xenova ONNX mirror) built from the established five-route image-classification ladder. Verify-first probe: canonical q8 semantically broken (cats → jellyfish 18.1%), fp32 semantically correct (Egyptian cat 46.1%) — fp32 shipped and disclosed. Shared loader/worker with literal model ids, immutable conformance suite, and route-complete acceptance covering overview/basics/practical/wild/multimodel at desktop and mobile, including the real MobileViT → ViT escalation cascade.
